description: An estate driveway pathway at dusk, photographed in a one-point perspective looking down a pale gravel-and-stone paved path that recedes toward a dark treeline. The scene is flanked by a densely planted perennial garden border on the right side — masses of white hydrangea blooms in full peak form, with ornamental shrubs and ground covers. On the left, a manicured lawn extends toward tall mature oak trees whose canopies frame the pink-orange sky. The pathway itself is clean concrete or pale limestone pavers with a gravel edge. Multiple post-mounted fixtures line the right side of the path, each mounted on a bronzed or antique brass cylindrical post with a stone plinth base, diminishing in size toward the vanishing point. Each fixture casts a warm amber glow that illuminates the surrounding hydrangea blooms and gravel at its base. The sky above the treeline transitions from deep blue at the top to a warm apricot-pink along the horizon, signaling early dusk. The color palette is earth tones and soft neutrals — cream gravel, soft gray stone, bronze brass post — with white hydrangea accents and the pink sky providing warmth. Camera is at a slightly low standing height, level pitch, in a strict one-point perspective centered on the path's vanishing point toward the treeline. A lighting fixture matching the product reference image is installed naturally within this scene at the appropriate location for the product category. Render the fixture exactly per the reference image — preserve all proportions, materials, finishes, and design details.
